description: This file is a Java source file that implements a functional test suite for the rusEfi firmware. It contains a class 'AutoTest' with multiple static methods for testing various engine configurations and behaviors, using commands, assertions, and waveform analysis.

classes.name: AutoTest
classes.description: Main class providing static methods to run various engine tests, send commands, and perform assertions on waveform data.

methods.name: mainTestBody
methods.description: Executes a sequence of engine tests with different configurations and checks.

methods.name: testCustomEngine
methods.description: Tests custom engine settings by sending specific commands.

methods.name: testMazdaMiata2003
methods.description: Configures engine type and performs dummy commands to test coverage.

methods.name: testCamaro
methods.description: Sets engine type for Camaro model.

methods.name: testSachs
methods.description: Sets engine type and adjusts RPM, placeholder for additional tests.

methods.name: testBmwE34
methods.description: Configures Bmw E34 engine, tests waveform patterns at different RPMs.

methods.name: testMitsu
methods.description: Configures Mitsubishi engine type and adjustments.

methods.name: testCitroenBerlingo
methods.description: Sets engine type for Citroen Berlingo.

methods.name: setEngineType
methods.description: Sends command to set engine type and enables self-stimulation.

methods.name: testMazda626
methods.description: Tests Mazda 626 engine with waveform assertions.

methods.name: test2003DodgeNeon
methods.description: Performs complex waveform assertions for Dodge Neon, including RPM changes and sensor checks.

methods.name: testMazdaProtege
methods.description: Tests Mazda Protege engine waveforms during cranking and running.

methods.name: test1995DodgeNeon
methods.description: Performs comprehensive waveform tests for Dodge Neon, including fuel maps and trigger modes.

methods.name: testRoverV8
methods.description: Configures Rover V8 engine.

methods.name: testFordFiesta
methods.description: Tests waveform patterns for Ford Fiesta.

methods.name: testFord6
methods.description: Tests waveform patterns for a 6-cylinder Ford engine and trigger type change.

methods.name: testFordAspire
methods.description: Extensive testing of a Ford Aspire engine, including waveform patterns, fuel maps, and mode switches.

methods.name: sendCommand
methods.description: Sends a command with default or specified timeout settings.

methods.name: sendComplexCommand
methods.description: Sends a command with longer timeout, used for complex commands.

methods.name: assertWave
methods.description: Validates waveform data for specific engine channels.

methods.name: assertWaveNull
methods.description: Checks that a waveform channel is null.

methods.name: assertWaveFall
methods.description: Checks waveform data for wave fall pattern.

methods.name: assertEquals
methods.description: Asserts that expected and actual values are approximately equal, with optional ratio.
